insight: Open-sourced by Hugging Face in late 2024; its entire core agent logic fits in roughly 1,000 lines of code.
name: smolagents
tagline: Barebones Python library for agents that think in code.
description: Hugging Face's minimal agent library: agents express their actions as executable Python code snippets rather than JSON tool calls, which tends to take fewer steps than tool-calling loops. Model-agnostic via LiteLLM (local Transformers, OpenAI, Anthropic, and 100+ providers), with sandboxed execution (E2B, Docker, Modal) and tools/agents shareable on the Hugging Face Hub.

modelSupport.notes: Any LLM via LiteLLM — local Transformers, Inference providers, OpenAI, Anthropic, and more.

edge: Agents 'think in code' — actions are executable Python snippets instead of JSON tool calls, which the docs say cuts step count by about 30%.
cons: Smaller feature surface than larger frameworks
